Package net.maswag.falcaun.temporal

package net.maswag.falcaun.temporal
Temporal-logic specifications, their robustness semantics, and the management of the specifications.

TemporalLogic is the interface of the STL and LTL formulas. Formulas are usually constructed by parsing strings with STLFactory or LTLFactory. The specifications to verify are managed by an AdaptiveSTLUpdater, e.g., StaticSTLList or the strengthening AdaptiveSTLList.
